name: Mooshika Vahana
text:
मूषिकवाहन मोदकहस्त चामरकर्ण विलम्बितसूत्र ।
वामनरूप महेश्वरपुत्र विघ्नविनायक पाद नमस्ते ॥
meaning: I bow to Ganesha, who rides the mouse, holds a sweet, has broad ears and is the son of Maheshwara, the remover of obstacles.
purpose: A descriptive praise verse for Ganesha.
supports: Humility; listening before speaking; patience; attention to detail.
when: Before learning, or a conversation that requires listening.
note: Some words in this widely circulated verse have variant readings; pronunciation should be checked against the chosen source.
